body.kept: Whole in the author's words, kept at its middle, before the store was built: every utterance as it came, typed or spoken, the session's reading which, including two he sent while the session worked; typing slips and words the dictation misheard marked on the word, with what was written kept, and only where the meaning was plain. After each, the essence of the session's answer in its own voice, its errors kept as made. The work so far stands in engine/measure.ts, the bar, and engine/next/engine.ts, the engine's top as redrawn; what follows is appended.

name: A twelfth session: stores whole in themselves, the field as the roots they stand at, and the engine read through them
